sections.body: Space has two definitions within astronomy: space (or "outer space") is all that exists beyond Earth; more technically, it is the dimensions of length, width, and depth within which all things exist (as opposed to time, which is sometimes considered as a fourth dimension).

sections.source_html:
Glossary term: Space

Description: Space has two definitions within astronomy: space (or "outer space") is all that exists beyond Earth; more technically, it is the dimensions of length, width, and depth within which all things exist (as opposed to time, which is sometimes considered as a fourth dimension).

Related Terms:

  • Outer Space


See this term in other languages

Term and definition status: This term and its definition have been approved by a research astronomer and a teacher

The OAE Multilingual Glossary is a project of the IAU Office of Astronomy for Education (OAE) in collaboration with the IAU Office of Astronomy Outreach (OAO). The terms and definitions were chosen, written and reviewed by a collective effort from the OAE, the OAE Centers and Nodes, the OAE National Astronomy Education Coordinators (NAECs) and other volunteers. You can find a full list of credits here. All glossary terms and their definitions are released under a Creative Commons CC BY-4.0 license and should be credited to "IAU OAE".

If you notice a factual error in this glossary definition then please get in touch.

sections.source_html:
Related Media


The Horsehead Nebula

Caption: This image shows the Horsehead Nebula, located at a distance of about 1,300 light-years from Earth in the Orion constellation, one of the most iconic examples of a dark nebula. A dark nebula is a dense cloud of interstellar dust and cold gas that absorbs and scatters visible light, preventing background stars and glowing gas from reaching our eyes. This false-color image combines data captured through multiple narrowband filters, each isolating light from different elements in the nebula. The dark, horse-shaped silhouette appears sharply outlined against the luminous nebula behind it, where energetic radiation from nearby young stars causes the gas to glow. The uneven distribution of visible stars in this image is not random: regions rich in dust in the lower part of this image appear almost empty, while clearer areas reveal many background stars. The dust acts like a cosmic curtain, hiding stars that lie behind it while allowing stars in front of the cloud to remain visible. Studying such regions helps astronomers understand how nebulae serve as environments where new stars can form.
Credit: T.A.Rector (NOIRLab/NSF/AURA) and Hubble Heritage Team (STScI/AURA/NASA) credit link

media.caption_en: This image shows the Horsehead Nebula, located at a distance of about 1,300 light-years from Earth in the Orion constellation, one of the most iconic examples of a dark nebula. A dark nebula is a dense cloud of interstellar dust and cold gas that absorbs and scatters visible light, preventing background stars and glowing gas from reaching our eyes. This false-color image combines data captured through multiple narrowband filters, each isolating light from different elements in the nebula. The dark, horse-shaped silhouette appears sharply outlined against the luminous nebula behind it, where energetic radiation from nearby young stars causes the gas to glow. The uneven distribution of visible stars in this image is not random: regions rich in dust in the lower part of this image appear almost empty, while clearer areas reveal many background stars. The dust acts like a cosmic curtain, hiding stars that lie behind it while allowing stars in front of the cloud to remain visible. Studying such regions helps astronomers understand how nebulae serve as environments where new stars can form.
media.caption_ru: На этом изображении показана туманность Конская Голова, расположенная на расстоянии около 1,300 световых лет от Земли в созвездии Ориона, один из самых знаковых примеров тёмной туманности. Тёмная туманность — это плотное облако межзвёздной пыли и холодного газа, которое поглощает и рассеивает видимый свет, не позволяя фоновым звёздам и светящемуся газу достичь наших глаз. Это изображение в ложных цветах объединяет данные, полученные через несколько узкополосных фильтров, каждый из которых выделяет свет от разных элементов в туманности. Тёмный силуэт в форме лошади резко очерчен на фоне светящейся туманности позади него, где энергичное излучение от близлежащих молодых звёзд заставляет газ светиться. Неравномерное распределение видимых звёзд на этом изображении не случайно: области, богатые пылью в нижней части изображения, выглядят почти пустыми, в то время как более чистые области обнаруживают множество фоновых звёзд. Пыль действует как космический занавес, скрывая звёзды, находящиеся за ней, но позволяя звёздам перед облаком оставаться видимыми. Изучение таких областей помогает астрономам понять, как туманности служат средой, где могут формироваться новые звёзды.
media.alt_en: The Horsehead Nebula is a horse-shaped silhouette, surrounded by glowing gas and scattered stars.
media.alt_ru: Туманность Конская Голова — это силуэт в форме лошади, окружённый светящимся газом и рассеянными звёздами.
